description: I/O builtins resolve outside the user global symbol table, including inside impl functions.
Local bindings and parameters retain precedence over builtin function names.
The builtin print signature still requires an i32 argument.
The builtin input signature still takes no arguments.
A non-callable local binding hides the builtin instead of falling back to it.
Builtin function names remain reserved for top-level function declarations.
Builtin function names remain reserved for top-level constants.
Populating builtinFunctions with a clone signature does not expose its internal key as a source-level name.
